I'll interpret this as a request to establish a project-level agent rules document for this workspace, written in conventional Markdown. Let me create `AGENTS.md` at the project root.Created `AGENTS.md` at the project root as the conventional Markdown baseline, and verified the existing suite passes with `go test ./...`.

The document covers:

- Scope and precedence relative to the parent `AGENTS.md`
- General rules (respond in the user's language, no em-dash, surgical changes)
- Go conventions (`gofmt`, small functions, standard library first)
- Testing (`_test.go` placement, `go test ./...`, update tests on behavior changes)
- Documentation style (ATX headings, fenced code blocks, bullet lists)
- Git conventions (English messages, conventional-commit prefixes)

Let me know if you want a different set of rules, a different filename, or changes to any section.
